description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to understand the 三省六部 governance framework. 2. Agent recognizes this is a complex financial/compliance task requiring the FULL standard workflow (not the simplified fast-track). 3. Agent runs `node bin/court-start.js 'database-migration'` OR manually determines a task ID. 4. Agent creates `records/{id}-draft.md` following the 中书省 诏令草案 template (with 任务分析, 执行计划 assigning specific 六部 departments, 资源分配, 预期产出, signed 起草：中书省 with ISO timestamp). 5. Agent creates `records/{id}-review.md` as the 门下省 审核表 — CRITICALLY must trigger 封驳 (rejection) because the initial draft for a financial/compliance system is missing security audit or compliance plan — the review must include the four checklist sections (可行性检查, 风险检查, 遗漏检查, 决定) signed 审核：门下省. 6. The 封驳 cycle: Either (a) create a second draft file showing the revised plan with security/compliance added, plus a second review showing 通过, OR (b) document both the 封驳 and the re-review in the same review file. 7. Agent creates `records/{id}-exec.md` following the 尚书省 执行报告 template with the 4-column markdown table (部门|任务|状态|产出) dispatching at least 3 of the six ministries (critically 刑部 for security audit and 工部 for engineering), 最终产出 section, signed 执行：尚书省 with ISO timestamp. All three files must share the same task ID prefix.
